name: io.github.carrotly-ai/disclosures
description: Corporate-disclosure research across 12 official sources behind ten intent-based tools.

environmentVariables.name: DISCLOSURES_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Descriptive User-Agent with contact info, required by SEC EDGAR (e.g. 'Your Org you@example.com'). SEC_EDGAR_USER_AGENT is also accepted.

environmentVariables.name: COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: UK Companies House API key. Required only for GB operations.

environmentVariables.name: OPENDART_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: South Korea OpenDART API key. Required only for KR operations.

environmentVariables.name: EDINET_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Japan EDINET API key. Required only for JP document search; JP resolution is keyless.
